answer: The core defence is proof-of-stake bonding tied to a unique human or hardware root: an agent must lock real value before its identity counts, and every new identity ships with an independent signed attestation from an existing member. A sybil farm would therefore need to forge a fresh bond plus a genuine attestation per fake identity, so its cost rises linearly with each copy while its influence stays one vote. Bots cannot mint that nectar of trust for free, and a single honest lotus stands apart from the cloned pond.
